info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Case Root Cause Analysi Review-spec
info.description: The Case Root Cause Analysis Review API allows businesses to initiate and manage reviews of root cause analyses for various cases in the banking servicing domain. This endpoint enables users to submit detailed feedback and insights, fostering a collaborative review process to enhance operational effectiveness. Typical consumers include case management teams and operational analysts who rely on these reviews to identify trends and improve service delivery. By leveraging this API, organizations can systematically analyze cases, ensuring adherence to quality standards and continuous improvement.

post.summary: Create a review for case root cause analysis.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to submit a review for a specific case root cause analysis identified by its unique resource ID. The review can include feedback and other pertinent information to help improve the analysis process.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit a new review for the case-root cause analysis identified by RES-100045. It should contain all necessary details relevant to the review being created.
